A simple realtime example

The following code shows a simple example on how to use realtime I/O using Rose.

// roseTest.cpp - Realtime audio test, ver. 1.00
//

#include "../lib/include/pandora.h"
#include "../lib/include/Rose.h"
#include <stdexcept>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

SoundInfo* info;
SignalTable* t;
LoopOscillator* o;

#if defined (USE_PORTAUDIO)
    int audioCallback32 (const void *inputBuffer, void *outputBuffer,
        unsigned long framesPerBuffer, const PaStreamCallbackTimeInfo* timeInfo,
        PaStreamCallbackFlags statusFlags,  void *userData) {
    
        // input not used in this test...
        //float *in = (float*) inputBuffer;
        float *out = (float*) outputBuffer;
    
        (void) timeInfo;
        (void) statusFlags;
        
        for (unsigned long i = 0; i < framesPerBuffer; i++) {
            // TODO: Write your generation code here...
    
            double d = o->tick();
            *out++ = d; // *in++;
            *out++ = d;
        }
        
        return paContinue;
    } 
#endif
 
int main (int argc, char* argv[]) {
    try {
        cout << "[Realtime audio test, ver. 1.00]" << endl << endl 
             << "Written by Carmine E. Cella, 2005" << endl
             << "based on the Pandora Audio Framework" << endl
             << "web: www.cryptosound.org" << endl << endl;
                
        info = SoundInfo::instance ();
        info->samplingRate (44100);
        info->channels (2);
        t = new SignalTable (4096);
        t->gen (1, 1);
        o = new LoopOscillator (info, t);
        o->frequency (440);
        Rose e (info);
        
        vector <int> v = e.playbackDevices ();
        
        for (unsigned int i = 0; i < v.size (); i++) {
            cout << v[i] << endl << e.deviceInfo (v[i]) << endl;
        }
        
        cout << "select: ";
        int a = 0;
        cin >> a;
        
        e.playbackDevice (a);
        
        vector <int> v1 = e.recordDevices ();
        
        for (unsigned int i = 0; i < v1.size (); i++) {
            cout << v1[i] << endl << e.deviceInfo (v1[i]) << endl;
        }
        
        cout << "select: ";
        int b = 0;
        cin >> b;
        e.recordDevice (b);
        e.frames (32);
        cout << e.decodeError (e.start (audioCallback32 )) << endl;
        getchar ();
        e.stop ();
    }
    catch (runtime_error& e) {
        cout << "Runtime error: " << e.what () << endl;
        getchar ();
    }
    catch (exception& e) {
        cout << "Generic exception: " << e.what () << endl;
        getchar ();
    }
    catch (...) {
        cout << "Fatal error: unknown exception" << endl;
        getchar ();
    }
    return 0;
}
